stage: development only; no test recording, fresh recording or test scene was read
note: First formal development run; the rule was written after the diagnostic trials in diagnosis/.
rule: Written after the diagnostic trials on development material (results-tone-forecaster-02/diagnosis) and before the formal development run. Candidates, all gated: the line-finder bank with a 0.2 s memory floor for line-finder tones (floor_lines0.2), and the line-finder bank with the joint band check (joint). Eligible only if, on development material: (a) whole-band boosts (whole 35-350 Hz band below -0.5 dB at either horizon, any development recording) are no more than v2 + gate has; (b) third-octave boosts (a third-octave band 1 dB or more louder, any development recording and horizon) are no more than v2 + gate has and fewer than bank_wide_lines + gate has; (c) near-boosts (a band 0.5 dB or more louder, same cases) are fewer than v2 + gate has and fewer than bank_wide_lines + gate has, a margin because study 01's candidate passed (b) on development and failed it on test; (d) third-octave boosts in the late windows of the synthetic development scenes are fewer than v2 + gate has and fewer than bank_wide_lines + gate has; (e) the tone gain is kept: the median, over development acoustic recordings with reference tones, of the tone-bin gain averaged over both horizons is at least v2 + gate's plus half of the amount by which bank_wide_lines + gate exceeds v2 + gate; (f) the median whole-band gain over development acoustic recordings, averaged over both horizons, is at least v2 + gate's minus 0.1 dB; (g) the mean synthetic development objective is at least v2 + gate's minus 0.5 dB and its synthetic windows below -0.5 dB are no more than v2 + gate has; (h) its own compute time per 10 ms block, excluding the tone-selector update that v2 also runs, is below 5 ms at the 99th percentile on every development recording and scene (offline Python, one thread, measured under the parallel pool). Among eligible candidates, pick the one with the fewest near-boosts (development recordings plus late synthetic windows, 0.5 dB or more); ties go to the higher tone-bin median. If none is eligible, no candidate is frozen and v2 stays.
labels: Reference-signal prediction only. Not acoustic attenuation.
